tone.mp3 is a generated one-second, 44.1 kHz stereo test signal, encoded by
LAME 3.100 at 192 kbps with its gapless tag. No recorded or third-party audio.
Left/right are 0.3*sin(2*pi*t*440/660) + 0.1*sin(2*pi*t*3700), quantized to
24-bit PCM before encoding. The expected decoded duration is 44,100 frames.
It was generated by artifacts/codec-study/selftest.c during the codec study.
